claim_scope: Transient beta-dependent zonalization of freely decaying turbulence; no sustained-jet claim is made because the solver has no forcing operator or injection budget.

secondary_diagnostics: spectral zonal fraction as a Parseval cross-check
zonal RMS divided by initial speed

controls: twelve failed E7 quotient-filter sentinel runs
numerical_gates: All states and metrics are finite.
Absolute normalized energy and enstrophy residuals are each <= 1e-6.
Time-step halving changes continuous endpoints by < 2 percent.
Grid refinement changes continuous endpoints by < 5 percent.
Refined modal jet count differs by at most one.

statistical_plan.pairing: Each nonzero-beta run is paired with beta zero at identical seed, drag, and viscosity.
statistical_plan.test: Exact two-sided sign-flip randomization test over twelve independent seed-cluster means.
statistical_plan.interval: Seed-clustered deterministic bootstrap interval with Bonferroni simultaneous 95 percent family coverage across eight primary contrasts.
statistical_plan.multiplicity: Holm familywise correction at alpha 0.05 for four beta levels and two endpoints.
statistical_plan.secondary_multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg at q=0.10; secondary results cannot rescue a failed primary family.
admission_rule: For beta 5 and 10, Holm-adjusted sign-flip p < 0.05 and simultaneous lower 95 percent confidence bound for zonal-fraction difference > 0.
For beta 5 and 10, estimated zonal-fraction difference >= 0.05.
For beta 5 and 10, Holm-adjusted sign-flip p < 0.05 and simultaneous lower 95 percent confidence bound for persistent-jet prevalence difference > 0.
For beta 5 and 10, estimated persistent-jet prevalence difference >= 0.50.

independent_reproduction.environment: fresh source checkout with pinned Python dependencies and no retained run cache
independent_reproduction.promotion_rule: A production result cannot enter the paper until the clean-environment digest and aggregate decision match.
